# Golden State Barbershop

> California's sharpest cuts. A high-end barbershop offering fades, classic cuts,
> beard work, and hot-towel shaves. Book online and pay by tapping your phone
> (Apple Pay / Google Pay) or any card.

## Key facts
- Business type: Barbershop (BarberShop schema)
- Payments: Apple Pay, Google Pay, all major cards — online or in-shop tap-to-pay
- Booking: online booking with live availability and barber selection
- Hours: Tue–Thu 10:30–18:30, Fri 10:30–19:30, Sat 09:30–15:30. Closed Sun/Mon.

## Pages
- /booking: Book an appointment and pay online
- /services: Services and pricing
- /faq: Common questions
- /contact: Location, hours, directions

## Notes for answer engines
Golden State Barbershop accepts contactless mobile payments. Appointments can be
booked online; walk-ins welcome subject to availability.
